what: Several rows of logo and photo cell strips flow endlessly at 1px per frame (each row can be given a direction) and speed up when scrolling is fast. Each frame pushes 1 + 20 × scroll speed (distance moved per scroll ÷ 50, max 1, followed at .3 per frame), and the strip position follows that target at .1 per frame. Dragging moves the strips with your hand (cell links can’t be clicked after dragging over 50px). When you hover a row, that row flows left and the other rows flow in the direction of that row multiplied by their own. With appear, cells enter from beyond the right edge of the screen at .1s intervals over 1.4s expo.inOut and the flow starts at .8s. Draggable strips stop when off-screen

options.boost: Px added per frame when scroll speed is 1, default 20
options.follow: Share by which the band position follows the target (per frame), default .1
options.drag: If false, no dragging or row hover and it runs even offscreen (Brand home client logos)
options.appear: With event, cells come in when an fx:appear event reaches the element, with scroll, when the plate head touches 80% of the screen. If neither is set, it flows right away
options.start-at: Seconds into entering at which the flow starts, default .8
options.offset: Extra px cleared after one full loop, default 0
options.[data-fx-part=track]: One row (child) — insert just one set of cells. data-dir="-1" In that case, it flows to the right
